digest.component_or_area: rebar_reconciler inbound probe and backend abstraction
propositions: Jira-specific probe logic (REST URL construction, basic-auth GET, status classification) is embedded in backend-neutral core module inbound_probe.py, preventing other vendors from implementing alternative probes

The probe vocabulary (ProbeBranch, ProbeResult, ProbeConfigError) must remain in inbound_probe.py at the package root due to location pinning and filename-based dynamic loading by reconcile_helpers.py
run_differs.py directly calls probe_mod.probe() without routing through a backend capability, making it impossible to dispatch vendor-specific probe implementations

Jira credentials resolution and status-name classification logic must be isolated into adapters/jira/probe.py to eliminate adapters.jira imports from core and establish a clean backend capability interface

A new SupportsAbsenceProbe capability protocol must be added to _backend.py and implemented by JiraBackend, with run_differs.py routing probe calls through capability guards and backends lacking the capability degrading to UNREACHABLE
